listing.name: Super Mario 64 (Super Mario 64: Recompiled)
listing.summary: A Super Mario 64 recompilation separate from matching-decompilation ports. The project reports Bob-omb Battlefield through the King Bob-omb star and a return to the castle, rather than a complete campaign. Windows/Linux x86-64 packages and a WebGPU browser route are documented. Linux needs glibc 2.35+, Vulkan, GTK 3 and FreeType. Use your own USA N64 ROM with SHA-1 9bef1128717f958171a4afac3ed78ee2bb4e86ce. Further accepted revisions and BIOS/firmware needs are unconfirmed. You and the project manage setup and updates; Portcove has not qualified a release package or confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Keep the complete permitted Windows player
steps.instruction: Use an independently permitted completed Windows copy of this specific implementation; the reviewed upstream route is v0.1.2. Keep SuperMario64Recompiled.exe, assets and all matching companions together. Finish any upstream source build outside Portcove. This is an existing-copy route, not managed package acquisition, source generation or a redistribution-rights grant.

steps.title: Select the native player and matching original
steps.instruction: Select SuperMario64Recompiled.exe and use the completed runtime folder containing assets as working directory. Leave arguments empty for the normal launcher, then use Load ROM and Start Game at the separate Play step. Use your own Super Mario 64 USA, big-endian .z64; documented SHA-1 9bef1128717f958171a4afac3ed78ee2bb4e86ce. The upstream player performs its own original check; Portcove registration does not import, normalize or authenticate the original.

steps.title: Keep the creating profile and portable mode
steps.instruction: The reviewed Windows profile defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%/SuperMario64Recompiled. An existing portable.txt in the working folder selects that folder instead. Keep the creating mode and actual locations; adding or removing the marker does not migrate existing data. Keep the whole profile, its original/EEPROM data, all JSON settings, controller profiles, mods and generated hires_font data. Preserve the complete runtime folder and any custom or external paths too. Edit settings only while the player is closed; registration does not move profiles or certify state compatibility between versions.

steps.title: Review registration before choosing Play
steps.instruction: Portcove records your selected native executable, working folder and literal arguments after review; Play is separate. Only the selected process is supervised. You or upstream own updates and runtime replacement; relink changed executable bytes after reviewing them. Removing the registration preserves all external files. Managed installation, backup, rollback, migration, generation and deletion are not offered for this copy.

warnings: Upstream reports Bob-omb Battlefield through King Bob-omb and return to the castle. Full-campaign, gameplay, physical controls and save compatibility are not established by this registration.
Use only software and original data you are permitted to use. Registration and owned-probe tests do not certify the upstream binary, full-game behavior or real save formats.
